en.headline: Prince of Wales Hospital investigates cancer drugs left out of fridge for 20 hours
en.dek: A support staff member and a dispenser at the Sir Yue-kong Pao Centre for Cancer failed to refrigerate a batch of drugs worth about HK$400,000 on 4 August; the manufacturer later confirmed stability was unaffected.
body: Prince of Wales Hospital confirmed on Monday that a batch of cancer drugs valued at about HK$400,000 was left outside a pharmaceutical refrigerator for roughly 20 hours because of a communication misunderstanding between a support staff member and a dispenser.

The incident occurred at midday on 4 August at the Sir Yue-kong Pao Centre for Cancer. The drugs were discovered the following morning and immediately returned to refrigerated storage. The hospital said it contacted the manufacturer, which confirmed that storage in an air-conditioned environment for about 20 hours remained within acceptable limits and would not affect stability or shelf life.

No patients’ treatment was affected. The hospital said it would take appropriate disciplinary action under established procedures, review the transport and storage workflow for refrigerated medicines, and remind all staff to follow the relevant guidelines. The incident has been reported to the Hospital Authority head office through the early incident notification system.

zh.headline: 威院癌症藥漏放雪櫃20小時 院方指溝通誤會將紀律處分
zh.dek: 沙田威爾斯親王醫院包玉剛爵士癌症中心一批約值40萬元癌症藥物因支援員工與配藥員溝通誤會未及時入雪櫃，生產商確認穩定性未受影響。
body: 威爾斯親王醫院周一確認，本月初一批約值40萬元的癌症藥物因溝通誤會未按規定及時放入藥用雪櫃，在空調環境存放約20小時。
事件於8月4日中午發生於包玉剛爵士癌症中心，涉及藥劑部一名支援職系員工及一名配藥員。藥物於翌日早上被發現後即時放回雪櫃。院方向生產商查詢後，獲確認在有空調環境下存放約20小時屬可接受範圍，不會影響藥物穩定性及儲存期。
院方強調沒有病人治療受影響，將按既定人事程序作出適當紀律處分，並全面檢視冷藏藥物運送及分工安排，提醒員工嚴格遵守指引。事件已透過早期事故通報系統向醫管局總辦事處呈報。
